turns.text: Thank you for contacting FastConnect technical support. This is Samuel. What can I help you with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, my internet has been extremely slow for the past three days. I'm supposed to have 500 megabits but I'm barely getting 50.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear you're experiencing slow speeds. That's definitely not acceptable. Let me look into this. Can I have your account number or phone number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My phone number is 555-2847.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I've pulled up your account and I can see you're subscribed to our Ultra 500 plan. How are you testing your speed?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm using speedtest.net on my desktop computer.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is your desktop connected via WiFi or ethernet cable?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's WiFi. Should I be using a cable?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: WiFi speeds can be affected by many factors. Let me check a few things first. Can you tell me the model of your modem? There should be a label on the device.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Let me look... It says NetGear CM1000.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, that's actually one of our older models. It's rated for up to 300 megabits, which means it physically cannot deliver the 500 megabit speeds you're paying for.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wait, so I've been paying for 500 megabits but my equipment can't even handle it?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Unfortunately, yes. When did you upgrade to the Ultra 500 plan?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: About six months ago. Nobody told me I needed new equipment.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're absolutely right - you should have been notified at the time of upgrade. I sincerely apologize for that oversight.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So I've been overpaying for six months for speeds I couldn't possibly get?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's correct, and I want to make this right. First, I'm going to send you our newest modem, the NetGear CM2000, which supports gigabit speeds and beyond.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: How much is that going to cost me?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: There's normally a $10 monthly rental fee, but I'm waiving that for the next 12 months. I'm also crediting your account for the difference in what you should have been getting.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: What kind of credit are we talking about?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me calculate this... You've been on the 500 plan for six months but were only able to receive 300 maximum. The difference between those plans is $20 per month, so I'm applying a $120 credit to your account.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, that seems fair. When will I get the new modem?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can have it shipped to you today with two-day delivery, so you'd receive it by Friday.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Is it difficult to install?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It's quite simple. The modem comes with step-by-step instructions, and it's basically just unplugging your old modem and plugging in the new one. However, if you'd prefer, I can schedule a technician to install it for you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: How much does a technician visit cost?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Normally it's $75, but given the circumstances, I'm waiving that fee as well if you'd like professional installation.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: You know what, if it's free, I'll take the technician. I don't want to risk messing something up.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Smart choice. What day works best for you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Can they come this Saturday?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me check availability... Yes, I have a window from 10 AM to 2 PM this Saturday. Does that work?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Perfect.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're all scheduled. The technician will bring the new modem, install it, and make sure you're getting your full 500 megabits before they leave.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great. Will I get a confirmation?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, you'll receive a confirmation email and text message with the appointment details.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Excellent. Thank you for taking care of this.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome. Again, I apologize for the equipment issue. Is there anything else I can help you with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that covers it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Alright. Enjoy your upgraded speeds after Saturday!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling BuyNow. This is Maria. How may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I need to speak with a manager immediately. This is the three time you've sent me a damaged product. This is completely unacceptable.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm very sorry to hear about this issue. I'd be happy to help you resolve this right away. Can you tell me more about what happened?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: What happened is that your company keeps sending damaged products. I've been patient, but this is ridiculous. I'll be filing a formal complaint with regulatory authorities.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I completely understand your frustration, and I want to make this right. Let me pull up your order history so I can see what's been going on.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Every time I call, I get promises that it will be fixed, but then the same thing happens again. I'm done being patient.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can see your account now, and I see you've had three orders with issues. This is definitely not the experience we want you to have. I'm going to personally ensure this gets resolved.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: How? You're going to say the same things the other representatives said. I want a manager, and I want replacement for all the time and frustration this has caused.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm going to connect you with my supervisor right now. And before I do, let me document that we'll be providing you with a full replacement and additional compensation for your trouble.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine. But if this doesn't get resolved today, I'm moving forward with legal action.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand completely. My supervisor is Olivia, and they'll have full authority to resolve this for you. Please hold while I transfer you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: SecureBank. This is Daniel. How may I assist you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I need to extend my reservation by two nights, report an issue with my room, and ask about your spa services.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll be happy to help with all three. Can I get your reservation number?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I see you're currently in room 876 with a executive suite. You're scheduled to check out on Friday. You'd like to extend through Tuesday?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that's correct. Also, the air conditioning in my room isn't working properly.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I apologize for that. I'm sending maintenance to your room right now. If they can't fix it immediately, would you like us to move you to a comparable room?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Let's see if they can fix it first. Now, do you have spa services available?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, our spa is open daily from 9 AM to 8 PM. We offer massages, facials, and body treatments. Would you like me to make a reservation?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Can I get a massage tomorrow afternoon?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Absolutely. I have availability at 2 PM or 4 PM for a 90-minute session.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: 2 PM works. And the room extension?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Confirmed for two additional nights at the same rate. Maintenance should be at your room within 15 minutes. Anything else?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that's everything. Thank you!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling ReliableInsure. This is David. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I've been trying to resolve an issue for over two weeks now and I keep getting transferred around. My wire transfers keep failing.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I apologize for the difficulties you've experienced. Let me pull up your account and see what's happening.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I've already explained this to multiple different people. Each time I'm told it's fixed, but it's not.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand your frustration. Can you provide your account number so I can review the history?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's 7554-2625-3216. But honestly, I don't think you can help me. I need to speak with a supervisor.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I completely understand. Before I transfer you, let me quickly review your account to brief them on the situation. That way you won't have to explain everything again.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine, but make it quick. I've wasted enough time on this.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm looking at your beneficiary details now. I can see you've attempted several wire transfers in the past over two weeks, and all have failed with error code 9104.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes! And nobody can tell me what that error means or how to fix it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Error 9104 typically indicates a transfer limits failure. Have you recently made any changes to your verification process?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, nothing has changed. I've been using this same verification process without problems for a long time.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's very strange. Let me check something... I'm seeing that our system flagged your verification process for verification after a security check last month. That's why the wire transfers are failing.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Why wasn't I notified about this? And why didn't the other agents see this?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I sincerely apologize. This should have been communicated to you. I can verify your verification process right now, which will resolve the issue.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I still want to speak with a supervisor. This has been incredibly frustrating and I want to file a formal complaint.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Absolutely, you have every right to speak with a supervisor. Let me get your verification process verified first so we can prevent any further issues, and then I'll transfer you directly to my supervisor.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Seaside Resort guest services, this is Daniel. How may I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I'm in room 412 and the air conditioning isn't working properly. It's way too warm in here.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Let me send maintenance to check it right away. Are you in the room now?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, I'm here for the next hour.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect. I'm dispatching a technician. They should be there within 15 minutes.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you. While I have you, I'd also like to book a spa appointment. Do you have any availability today?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me check with the spa... What service are you interested in?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: A massage, preferably 60 minutes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I have a 60-minute Swedish massage available at 3 PM or 5:30 PM today.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: 3 PM works perfectly. What's the cost?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The 60-minute massage is $120, plus gratuity. I can charge it to your room.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, please do that. Room 412.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're all booked. Report to the spa at 2:45 PM for check-in.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great. One more thing - I'm checking out tomorrow but my flight isn't until 6 PM. Can I get a late checkout?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Our standard checkout is 11 AM. Let me see what I can arrange... I can offer you late checkout until 2 PM for a $50 fee.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Is there any way to waive that fee since I'm having the AC issue?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's a fair request. Let me speak with my supervisor... Yes, I can waive the late checkout fee as our apology for the air conditioning problem.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I appreciate that, thank you. So maintenance is coming to fix the AC, I have a spa appointment at 3 PM, and late checkout tomorrow at 2 PM?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Exactly right. Is there anything else you need?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that's everything. Thank you for your help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: My pleasure. Enjoy your spa treatment!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, thank you for contacting StayComfort. This is James. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello, I'm calling about an order that shows delivered but I never received it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. I'll definitely help you look into this. Can I get your order number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's 1729266. The tracking was marked delivered yesterday afternoon, but there was nothing at my door.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me pull that up right away. Okay, I see the order for a gaming controller. The tracking does show it was delivered by regional carrier. Do you have cameras or neighbors who might have seen the delivery?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I've checked with my neighbors and looked at my security camera footage. Nothing shows a delivery. I've been home all day too.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's definitely concerning. The carrier's note says it was left at the front porch. Is that your usual delivery location?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, but it's not there. I've checked everywhere. Could it have been delivered to the wrong address?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's possible. Let me start an investigation with regional carrier. I'm also going to file a claim on our end. In the meantime, would you like me to send a replacement?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, please. I really need this gaming controller. How long will the replacement take?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can get a replacement shipped out today with expedited delivery at no extra charge. You should have it within 2-3 business days. I'm also adding a note to use signature confirmation.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you. What about the investigation?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The carrier investigation usually takes 5-7 business days. If they locate the package or determine what happened, we'll contact you. You won't be charged twice - this is completely on us.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I appreciate that. This is the first time I've had this issue with your company.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your patience and understanding. Your replacement order confirmation will be sent to your email shortly. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling DeviceCare technical support. This is Joseph. How can I assist you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I updated my video editing software yesterday and now it won't complete the loading process I try to launch it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear you're experiencing issues after the update. That's definitely frustrating. Can you tell me which version you updated to?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I think it was version 12.6. The update installed automatically.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I see. There have been some reported compatibility issues with that version on certain system configurations. Let me check your system setup. Are you on Windows or Mac?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: macOS Ventura. I have a fairly new computer, so I don't think that's the issue.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me look into this... The issue seems to be related to the codec library in the new version conflicting with your hardware acceleration. This is affecting a small percentage of users.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, so how do I fix it? I need this software for work and I have deadlines.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I completely understand the urgency. I can guide you through rolling back to the stable version, which was stable. Alternatively, there's a hotfix patch that was just released this morning that should resolve the issue. Which would you prefer?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: If there's a fix available, I'd rather try that first instead of downgrading.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Absolutely. I'm sending you a link to download the hotfix patch right now. It's a small file, about 109MB. Once you download it, run the installer and it will patch the codec library issue.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, I'm downloading it now. Should I uninstall the current version first?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No, don't uninstall. The patch will install over the existing version. Just make sure the video editing software is closed when you run the patch installer.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Got it. The download is complete. I'm running it now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect. The installation should take about 2-3 minutes. Once it's done, try launching the video editing software again. I'll stay on the line with you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, the patch is installed... Let me try opening the software... It's working! Thank you so much!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Excellent! I'm glad we got that resolved. If you experience any other issues, don't hesitate to call back. Is there anything else I can help with today?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: ShopDirect customer service, this is Elena. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I received my order yesterday but one of the items arrived damaged. It's a glass vase and it's completely shattered.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm so sorry to hear that. Let me help you right away. Can I have your order number?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I can see the vase in your order. Would you like a replacement or a refund?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'd like a replacement, but can you guarantee it won't break again?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Absolutely. I'm flagging this for extra protective packaging. You'll receive the replacement in 3-4 business days with expedited shipping at no charge.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, good. Do I need to return the broken one?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No, you can dispose of it safely. We don't need damaged glass returned for safety reasons.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Perfect. While I have you, I also have a $15 promotional credit from last month. Can I use it on an order I just placed?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me check... Yes, I can see the $15 credit in your account. What's the order number for the new order?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm applying the credit now... Done. Your total has been reduced by $15. You'll see the adjustment on your receipt.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great. Actually, when will that order ship? I haven't gotten a confirmation yet.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me check the status... It's currently being prepared in our warehouse. It should ship later today and you'll receive tracking information by email this evening.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: How long will delivery take?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Standard shipping is 5-7 business days. Would you like me to upgrade you to expedited shipping for $8?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, standard is fine. So just to recap - I'm getting a replacement vase with better packaging, my $15 credit has been applied, and my new order ships today?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Exactly correct. You'll receive confirmation emails for both the replacement vase and the shipping notification.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Excellent. Thank you so much.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're very welcome. We apologize again for the damaged item. Have a great day!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling CloudTech technical support. This is Joshua. What can I help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My mobile data has been out for three days and I really need it working. I work from home and this is affecting my job.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm very sorry to hear your mobile data is down. I understand how important this is. Let me pull up your account and run some diagnostics.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I've already tried restarting my device multiple times. Nothing works.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I appreciate you trying that. Let me check our system... I can see your account and I'm running a remote diagnostic on your device now. Can you tell me what lights are showing on your device?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The power light is on, but the data connection light is blinking red.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, that helps. The blinking red light indicates a network coverage issue. Let me check the cell tower in your area... Ah, I see there's a reported outage affecting your neighborhood. A fiber line was damaged during construction work.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So there's nothing wrong with my device? How long until it's fixed?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Correct, your device is fine. Our technicians are on site now repairing the damage. The estimated restoration time is within 6 hours.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's still several hours away. Is there anything else I can do? I have an important meeting.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand the urgency. What I can do is provide you with a temporary backup solution at no charge. Would that help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that would be very helpful. Thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great. I'm setting that up for you now. You'll receive instructions via text message within the next 10 minutes. I'm also crediting your account for the three days of outage. Is there anything else I can help with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that's all. I appreciate your help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling CoverageFirst. This is Jessica. How may I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I received a denial letter for a medical claim and I'm really confused because I know this procedure is covered under my plan. It was for a specialist consultation for my knee.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear about the denial. I'll be happy to review this with you. Can I get your member ID number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's 66296539. The claim number is 539560.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Let me pull up your claim... I see the claim for the specialist consultation. According to the notes, it was denied due to lack of referral requirements.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: But my doctor said everything was submitted correctly. They've done this many times before with your company.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand your frustration. Let me check the details... I'm looking at what was submitted. It appears the referral requirements documentation was submitted, but it was submitted three days after the procedure was performed.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So it was denied just because of timing? That seems really unfair. I was in pain and needed the specialist consultation right away.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I completely understand. In cases where there's a medical emergency or urgent medical necessity, we can file an appeal. Did your doctor document that this was urgent or causing significant pain?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, absolutely. I had been dealing with severe knee pain for weeks, and it was affecting my ability to work.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's important information. What I can do is initiate a referral requirements appeal for you right now. I'll need to get some documentation from your provider's office, but this type of appeal usually has a good chance of approval.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: How long will that take?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The appeal process typically takes 30 business days, but I can request an expedited review which would be 72 hours. In the meantime, please don't pay the bill - wait for the appeal decision.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, thank you. I was worried I'd be stuck with a huge bill.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome. I'm sending the appeal request now, and you'll receive a confirmation email. I'll also note that you were experiencing significant pain requiring urgent specialist visit. Is there anything else I can help clarify?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, thank you for contacting JourneyPlus. This is Rachel. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello, I'm calling about an order that shows delivered but I never received it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. I'll definitely help you look into this. Can I get your order number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's 4832870. The tracking shows it arrived three days ago, but there was nothing at my door.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me pull that up right away. Okay, I see the order for a smart watch. The tracking does show it was delivered by USPS. Do you have cameras or neighbors who might have seen the delivery?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I've checked with my neighbors and looked at my security camera footage. Nothing shows a delivery. I've been home all day too.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's definitely concerning. The carrier's note says it was left at the back entrance. Is that your usual delivery location?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, but it's not there. I've checked everywhere. Could it have been delivered to the wrong address?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's possible. Let me start an investigation with USPS. I'm also going to file a claim on our end. In the meantime, would you like me to send a replacement?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, please. I really need this smart watch. How long will the replacement take?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can get a replacement shipped out today with expedited delivery at no extra charge. You should have it within 2-3 business days. I'm also adding a note to use signature confirmation.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you. What about the investigation?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The carrier investigation usually takes 5-7 business days. If they locate the package or determine what happened, we'll contact you. You won't be charged twice - this is completely on us.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I appreciate that. This is the first time I've had this issue with your company.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your patience and understanding. Your replacement order confirmation will be sent to your email shortly. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: JourneyPlus support, this is Christopher. How can I assist you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm having internet disconnecting, plus I want to downgrade my plan to save money, and I need to update my payment method.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can help with all of that. Let's start with the internet disconnecting. How long has this been happening?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: About a week. It happens multiple times a day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me run diagnostics... I'm seeing signal quality issues. I'll send a firmware update to your equipment remotely. This should fix it within 30 minutes.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great. Now about downgrading - I'm paying too much for speed I don't use.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. Your current plan is 456 Mbps at $86/month. We have a 154 Mbps plan at $47/month. Would that work?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that's perfect. And I need to switch my payment to a new credit card.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can process both changes. The plan change takes effect next billing cycle. Can I get your new card info?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [Provides card ending in 9733]

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Updated. You'll save $21/month starting next cycle, and your new card is set for auto-pay.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Perfect, thank you!

turns.speaker: agent
